When you reach a Sorcerer level specified in the Draconic Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

**Draconic Spells**

| Sorcerer Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 3 | *{ref:spell/alter-self}*, *{ref:spell/chromatic-orb}*, *{ref:spell/command}*, *{ref:spell/dragons-breath}* |
| 5 | *{ref:spell/fear}*, *{ref:spell/fly}* |
| 7 | *{ref:spell/arcane-eye}*, *{ref:spell/charm-monster}* |
| 9 | *{ref:spell/legend-lore}*, *{ref:spell/summon-dragon}* |
